evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: Distinct search approach (content identification/fingerprinting) compared to other discovery stories.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Different actor/context (personal profile-based discovery) than other discovery stories.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Distinct requirement (collaborative filtering / similar users) vs other discovery methods.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music or ringback tones similar to a given music video based on content similarity
evaluations.rationale: Specific use case (similarity to a given music video) different from other discovery stories.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music by exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Discovery based on enriched metadata/tags is a distinct search approach.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps
evaluations.rationale: Upload/tag availability requirement is distinct from search/discovery or analysis stories.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: UI-oriented story (thumbnail sequences) not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: General 'similar items' info request is distinct; related perceptual qualifier appears in a later story.

evaluations.evidence: perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Substantially duplicates ZO-008's 'similar video items and segments' with only a narrow qualifier ('perceptually') and no meaningful difference in actor, context, goal or business rule.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: Recommendation by similar profiles is a distinct recommendation source.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: Geographically- and news-driven recommendations differ from profile-based recommendations.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Person identification and enrichment is a distinct recognition requirement.

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Product identification is a different target domain than person/logo/brand identification.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Logo identification is a separate recognition goal.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Brand identification is distinct from logos, people, or products.

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image, so that I am recommended with videos related to that picture or image
evaluations.rationale: Image-to-video recommendation is a specific cross-modal requirement not present elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: walk around, access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area
evaluations.rationale: Geo-based content discovery is a unique context and goal.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: ASR-based search is a distinct search modality.

evaluations.evidence: see, validate and edit segmentation of videos
evaluations.rationale: Admin segmentation validation/editing is distinct from other segmentation or thumbnail stories.

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment
evaluations.rationale: Annotation and topic extraction is a different admin task than segmentation validation.

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects
evaluations.rationale: Quality-based filtering/ranking is a unique ranking criterion.

evaluations.evidence: get a quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload
evaluations.rationale: Tampering/edited-audio assessment is a distinct detection task.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Specific content-type prefilter (nudity) is not the same as general prefilter tasks.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter content using search based on low­level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Low-level asset information prefiltering is a distinct technical approach.

evaluations.evidence: automatically validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: Copyright validation is a unique compliance check.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter the content using search on high­level asset information such as metadata and tags
evaluations.rationale: High-level metadata/tag-based prefiltering differs from low-level prefiltering and specific content filters.

evaluations.evidence: assess how interesting or appealing or complex a picture is based on automated analysis, citizen annotations, and comments on Talk
evaluations.rationale: Interest/appeal assessment combining multiple signals is a distinct analytic requirement.

evaluations.evidence: detect when a scientist should be prompted to look at a subject, based on annotations and information from Talk comments
evaluations.rationale: Scientist-prompt detection is a distinct decision-making requirement.

evaluations.evidence: identify volunteer types
evaluations.rationale: Volunteer-typing is a unique classification goal separate from other admin analytics.

evaluations.evidence: preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low­level image features
evaluations.rationale: Project-specific preclassification (Galaxy Zoo) using low-level features is distinct from other preclassifications.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals in them
evaluations.rationale: Project-specific detection (Snapshot Serengeti, no classifiable animals) differs in context from other projects.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic image series detection for the case of timestamping malfunction in Snapshot Serengeti images
evaluations.rationale: A specific detection task (image series/timestamp malfunction) is unique.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Species preclassification (Snapshot Serengeti) is distinct from other preclassification tasks.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Attribute preclassification is a different output than species or number detection.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Animal count detection is a distinct analytic requirement.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic segmentation or localization of plankton in Plankton Portal
evaluations.rationale: Segmentation/localization for plankton is a unique processing need.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton in them
evaluations.rationale: Project-specific detection (Plankton Portal) differs in context from similar Snapshot Serengeti story.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic detection of plankton size or orientation in Plankton Portal images
evaluations.rationale: Size/orientation detection is a different analytic output than presence/segmentation/species.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic preclassification of plankton species in Plankton Portal images
evaluations.rationale: Species preclassification for plankton is distinct from other plankton tasks.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic worm motion analysis to reduce video duration in Worm Watch Lab
evaluations.rationale: Project-specific motion analysis aimed at reducing video duration is unique.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect the time in a Worm Watch Lab video where the worm lays an egg
evaluations.rationale: Event detection (egg-laying) is a distinct analytic requirement.

evaluations.evidence: detect important features such as areas of flooding, damage, temporary shelters, blocked roads etc in the satellite images
evaluations.rationale: Satellite-image feature detection is a unique domain-specific requirement.

evaluations.evidence: assess the probability/weight of a volunteer’s classification based on their experience
evaluations.rationale: Assessing volunteer classification weight is a distinct analytics requirement.

evaluations.evidence: perform prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts such as bright stars and camera read errors
evaluations.rationale: Artifact removal prefilter is a specific image-cleaning requirement.

evaluations.evidence: detect moving and transient objects in the images
evaluations.rationale: Moving/transient object detection is a distinct detection goal.

evaluations.evidence: remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files
evaluations.rationale: Audio denoising is a different processing task than other audio analyses listed.

evaluations.evidence: group whale calls that are similar
evaluations.rationale: Clustering whale calls is distinct from counting or denoising tasks.

evaluations.evidence: identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file
evaluations.rationale: Counting whales in audio is a unique analytic requirement.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should interrupt a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: General decision of when to interrupt is distinct from decisions about medium or education content.

evaluations.evidence: whether I should interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Substantially contained in ZO-049 (decision to interrupt); this refines medium without a meaningful difference in actor/context/goal, so treated as duplicate.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should educate a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Decision of when to educate is distinct from identifying content/medium of education.

evaluations.evidence: whether I should educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Substantially contained in ZO-051 (decision to educate); specifying medium is a narrow refinement and does not create a meaningful difference in actor/context/goal.

evaluations.evidence: know which piece of education I should give to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Selecting which educational piece to give is a different requirement than deciding when to educate.

evaluations.evidence: know when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Detecting interesting comments is distinct from other Talk/notification stories.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Determining when Zoonibot should comment is a distinct automation decision.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should give an explanation
evaluations.rationale: Specific decision about Zoonibot giving explanations differs from general commenting.

evaluations.evidence: know what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Determining Zoonibot content is a different requirement than timing decisions.

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: Admin grouping by similarity is distinct from user-facing similar-item info and other grouping/cluster tasks.

evaluations.evidence: recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences
evaluations.rationale: Project recommendation for volunteers is a different recommendation target than content or project-agnostic recommendations.

evaluations.evidence: see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them
evaluations.rationale: Admin article summary/reuse capability is a unique requirement.
